metadata.description: RAN5 Phase-4 CQ — CR 변경 근거/Cross-Spec/CR Pack 검증

questions.question: 특정 CR의 변경 이유(reasonForChange)는?
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:CR {tdocNumber: 'R5-261671'}) RETURN c.reasonForChange AS reasonForChange LIMIT 1

questions.question: 특정 CR의 변경 요약(summaryOfChange)은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:CR {tdocNumber: 'R5-261671'}) RETURN c.summaryOfChange AS summaryOfChange LIMIT 1

questions.question: 특정 CR의 미승인 영향(consequencesIfNotApproved)은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:CR {tdocNumber: 'R5-261671'}) RETURN c.consequencesIfNotApproved AS consequences LIMIT 1

questions.question: 특정 CR이 영향주는 다른 Spec 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:CR)-[r:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->(s:Spec) WHERE c.tdocNumber = 'R5-255419' RETURN c.tdocNumber, type(r) AS relType, s.specNumber ORDER BY s.specNumber

questions.question: 특정 Spec을 수정하는 CR 중 다른 Spec에도 영향주는 CR은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(s:Spec {specNumber: '38.521-1'}) WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (c)-[:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->() } RETURN c.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber ORDER BY c.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: 특정 Spec을 영향 받는 Spec으로 참조하는 CR 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (s:Spec {specNumber: '38.533'})<-[:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]-(c:CR) RETURN c.tdocNumber, c.summaryOfChange ORDER BY c.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: Cross-Spec 영향이 가장 많은 CR Top 10은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:CR)-[r:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->() WITH c, count(r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10 RETURN c.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, cnt

questions.question: 특정 CR Pack에 포함된 CR 목록과 변경 요약은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (pack:CRPack)-[:HAS_CR]->(c:CR) WITH pack, c ORDER BY c.tdocNumber LIMIT 10 RETURN pack.crPackId AS crPackId, c.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, c.summaryOfChange AS summary

questions.question: 특정 Work Item 관련 CR이 속한 Pack 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:CR)-[:RELATED_TO]->(w:WorkItem) WHERE w.workItemCode CONTAINS '5GS_NR_LTE-UEConTest' WITH c MATCH (c)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(pack:CRPack) RETURN DISTINCT pack.crPackId AS crPackId, pack.tsgMeeting AS tsgMeeting ORDER BY toInteger(split(pack.tsgMeeting, '#')[1]) DESC, crPackId ASC LIMIT 10

questions.question: 특정 TSG 회의(RAN#111)에 제출된 CR Pack 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (pack:CRPack {tsgMeeting: 'RAN#111'})-[:HAS_CR]->(cr:CR) RETURN pack.crPackId AS crPackId, pack.tsgMeeting AS tsgMeeting, count(cr) AS crCount ORDER BY crPackId ASC LIMIT 10
questions.expected: CR Packs submitted to TSG RAN#111 with CR count

questions.question: 특정 Section을 수정하는 CR의 변경 이유 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (sec:Section {sectionNumber: '6.2'})-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.521-1'}) MATCH (sec)<-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]-(c:CR) RETURN c.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, c.reasonForChange AS reason ORDER BY toInteger(replace(sp.specRelease,'Rel-','')) DESC, c.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: 특정 Conclusion이 다루거나 참조하는 CR의 변경 이유와 요약은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (con:Conclusion)-[:ABOUT_TDOC|REFERENCES]->(c:CR) MATCH (c)-[:REVISED_TO*0..]->(f:Tdoc) WHERE f.reasonForChange IS NOT NULL WITH DISTINCT c, f ORDER BY c.tdocNumber DESC, f.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN c.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, f.tdocNumber AS agreedTdocNumber, f.reasonForChange AS reason, f.summaryOfChange AS summary
questions.expected: agreed revision of the CR referenced by a Conclusion

questions.question: 특정 Work Item 관련 CR이 수정하는 Section 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:CR)-[:RELATED_TO]->(w:WorkItem) WHERE w.workItemCode CONTAINS '5GS_NR_LTE-UEConTest' WITH c MATCH (c)-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]->(sec:Section) RETURN DISTINCT sec.sectionId AS sectionId ORDER BY sec.sectionId LIMIT 10

questions.question: 특정 회사의 CR이 영향주는 다른 Spec 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:CR)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(comp:Company) WHERE comp.companyName CONTAINS 'Samsung' WITH c MATCH (c)-[:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->(s:Spec) RETURN DISTINCT s.specNumber AS spec ORDER BY spec LIMIT 10

questions.question: 특정 회의에서 Conclusion이 다루거나 참조하는 CR의 변경 요약 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (con:Conclusion)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {meetingNumber: 'RAN5#94-e'}) WITH con MATCH (con)-[:ABOUT_TDOC|REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:REVISED_TO*0..]->(f:Tdoc) WHERE f.summaryOfChange IS NOT NULL RETURN DISTINCT t.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, f.tdocNumber AS agreedTdocNumber, f.summaryOfChange AS summary ORDER BY tdocNumber DESC, agreedTdocNumber DESC LIMIT 10
questions.expected: agreed revisions of CRs referenced by Conclusions at RAN5#94-e
